title: Normalized ramified finite pullback comparison for a single module sheaf
statement: Let l be prime, E and L finite extensions of Q_l, and ι:E→ₐ[Q_l]L. Let g:X→Y be a scheme morphism, e a natural number, j_n the given coefficient quotient ring homomorphisms, and source and target the normalized Coefficients data on Y and X [def-weil-ramified-pullback-tower-data]. Fix n. Write D^F_n for the ordinary module functor consisting of reduction from the completed coefficient ring, finite coefficient module pullback along g, and restriction to the completed coefficient ring [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined, def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. For every completed E coefficient module sheaf M on Y there is an isomorphism T_target(D^E_n M) ≅ D^L_index(e,n)(T_source M). On the section tensor s⊗(b·g*(a⊗p)), it sends this element to j_n(b)π^L_index(e,n)(s)·g*(j_n(a)⊗(1⊗p)), exactly as in the Lean attachment. This statement asserts only objectwise isomorphisms and their section formula at this fixed level: it asserts no naturality, complexes, or tower compatibility. No positivity or monotonicity of e or quotient-representative formula for j is needed once the Coefficients data are supplied.

proof.text: Apply the single-site coefficient base-change isomorphism on X to N=g*_E(reduce_E M). Its section formula sends s tensor (b·g*(a tensor p)) to π_L(s) tensor (b·g*(a tensor p)). This is the coefficient factor only; the remaining finite pullback and reduction still occur.

proof.text: Apply finiteScalarComposition_exists to identify finite scalar extension of g*_E(reduce_E M) with g*_L(reduce_L(extend_source M)). Restrict this isomorphism along the completed L projection, and compose it with the first isomorphism. The two proved formulas give the desired section formula, with commutativity exchanging π_L(s)j_X(b) and j_X(b)π_L(s).

lean.statement:
theorem finiteModuleComparison_exists {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (e : ℕ)
    (j : ∀ n : ℕ, Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1) →+*
      Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (index e n + 1))
    (source : Coefficients l E L ι e j Y) (target : Coefficients l E L ι e j X)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ d : ∀ M : integralTowerModules l E Y,
      (scalar.{t, u} target.completedMap).obj ((finitePullbackModule l E g n).obj M) ≅
        (finitePullbackModule l L g (index e n)).obj ((scalar.{t, u} source.completedMap).obj M),
      ∀ (M : integralTowerModules l E Y) (V : Y.ProEt)
        (a : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n).obj.obj (op V))
        (b : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n).obj.obj
          (op ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V)))
        (s : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X).obj.obj
          (op ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))) (p : M.val.obj (op V)),
      (d M).hom.val.app _
        (tensor.{t, u} target.completedMap ((finitePullbackModule l E g n).obj M)
          _ s (finitePullbackModuleTensor l E g n M V a b p)) =
        finitePullbackModuleTensor l L g (index e n) ((scalar.{t, u} source.completedMap).obj M) V
          ((ramifiedMap l E L Y e n (j n)).hom.app (op V) a)
          ((ramifiedMap l E L X e n (j n)).hom.app _ b *
            (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l L X (index e n)).hom.app _ s)
          (tensor.{t, u} source.completedMap M (op V) 1 p)
